name: pc-Minimality of the Two-Control Directed Cycles
statement: For every even $m\geq4$, $D_m$ has $m+2$ coordinates, $4m+4$ concepts, VC dimension two, and empty coefficient space. Every proper nonempty pc-minor is convex-realizable. Consequently the $D_m$ form an infinite antichain of pc-minimal obstructions to realizable ampleness inside the dismantlable ample and finite convex-treelike families, and they admit union-closed well-graded orientations.
proof: A private projection or zero-conditioning deletes one cycle vertex and gives the acyclic two-control path construction. A private one-conditioning gives a reflected five-vertex path learning space. A control conditioning becomes a downset after reflection and has uniform feasible rows. A control projection has no vertex rows and direct witnesses exist for every remaining row array. These cover every elementary operation; realizability is pc-minor closed. Different lengths have different cardinalities, and a proper minor relation between two members would contradict minimality.
